direction: Urgent, hushed; trying not to panic.
Fearful but focused; calling back over shoulder.
notes: Mouth flap starts quickly after Alex.

line: I said I’d protect this city.
You don’t have to do it alone.
Both of you, fall back to the eastern bridge!
Run! Get away from the tower!
The crystal is reacting to him.
At last, the heir has awakened.
A memory your kingdom tried to bury.
He stopped it... with his bare hands.
This power doesn’t belong to you!
No. It belongs to the one willing to use it.
